versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of the "dataify-youtube-product-by-id" skill

- Allows users to submit YouTube video information collection jobs to Dataify Builder by video ID.
- Guides users through API TOKEN handling, including secure saving and validation.
- Interactively confirms and allows editing of task parameters, defaults, and dropdown options.
- Supports collecting basic info for one or multiple YouTube videos in a single task.
- Normalizes input, validates required fields, and clearly displays confirmed parameters in Markdown tables.
- Provides step-by-step instructions and result access at Dataify dashboard.
